facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog post on planning programmatic campaigns was published on September 28, 2021.
StackAdapt's article presents three key steps to plan a programmatic campaign: forecasting, deciding on channels and tactics, and aligning creative assets and messaging.
facts.quote: 3 key steps to plan the perfect programmatic campaign

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, campaign forecasting can help answer two important pre-campaign questions.
facts.quote: Forecasting can help you find answers to two important pre-campaign questions:

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that display is generally the most cost-effective channel and provides both performance and scale.
facts.quote: Display provides both performance and scale and is generally the most cost-effective channel.

facts.fact: StackAdapt recommends hooking the target demographic within the first few seconds of an ad.
facts.quote: hook your target demographic in the first few seconds by using language or imagery that speaks to them
